c1_robust_is_not_sample_size_improvable.sd_source: line 541 _pooled_std returns statistics.pstdev(vals) -- the POPULATION standard deviation of the seed-level sin_angle values, not a standard error

even_if_repaired_to_standard_error.reading: Repairing the criterion is necessary but NOT sufficient. At the observed effect size and dispersion the design needs ~51 informative seeds, which at a 28.6% informative yield means ~177 raw seeds and ~31 h. The binding constraint is the informative-seed YIELD, not the bar.

yield_is_substrate_gated.correlation: corr(distance of D_action_mass_mean from saturation, norm_v_score) = 0.884 across all 14 seeds
yield_is_substrate_gated.reading: The score axis's measurable authority is very largely DETERMINED by how far the action-value mass sits from its 0/1 bounds. Where D is pinned the score-bias lever has nothing to act on, so its effect vector collapses toward zero and the sin_angle between a large temperature vector and a near-zero score vector becomes numerically ill-conditioned.

supporting.note_on_corr: Among seeds that ARE measurable the angle does not track score-axis magnitude (0.028), i.e. there is no systematic weak-axis-implies-collinear artifact WITHIN the informative pool. The 0.315 over all 14 is carried entirely by the saturated seeds, which is exactly why F2 excluding them was correct.

yield_is_substrate_gated.why_this_is_substrate_and_not_sampling: D_action_mass saturation is a property of an UNTRAINED agent's degenerate E3 action-value distribution -- either one action dominates (D -> 1) or values are flat (D -> 0). It is invariant to how long the cell is sampled: 777a gave every cell 250 clean selections and the saturation rate barely moved from 777's starved run. Sampling was the binding constraint in 777; it is demonstrably NOT the binding constraint in 777a.

targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: Adjudicated by failure_autopsy_MECH-063-777a-779a-cluster_2026-07-18. Direction corrected from the auto-derived 'weakens' to non_contributory; the self-route control_axes_collinear_toward_one_scalar is contradicted by the run's own numbers for the second consecutive iteration. All six preconditions were MET and the sampling defect of V3-EXQ-777 is genuinely repaired (F1: every cell reached 250 fresh E3 selections, all stopped_on floors_met, zero starved cells). C1 nonetheless failed -- but NOT on collinearity: mean_sin_angle 0.5454 EXCEEDS the 0.500 margin and c1_seed_count PASSED (3 of 4 informative seeds above margin, required 3). The sole failing bar is c1_robust, defined at script line 697 as (mean_sin - sd_sin) > SIN_MARGIN where sd_sin is statistics.pstdev across seeds (line 541) -- a POPULATION dispersion, not a standard error, so the bar cannot be met by adding seeds and conflates seed-to-seed variability with measurement noise. Repairing it to standard-error form is necessary but not sufficient: at the observed mean 0.545 and sd 0.323 the design needs ~51 informative seeds, and the observed informative yield is 4 of 14 (28.6%), implying ~177 raw seeds and ~31 h. The yield is substrate-gated, not sampling-gated: corr(distance of D_action_mass from saturation, norm_v_score) = 0.884, with 9 of 14 seeds saturated (7 ceiling, 2 floor) and a median v_temp/v_score magnitude asymmetry of 8.1x. Saturation is a property of an untrained agent's degenerate E3 action-value distribution and barely moved from V3-EXQ-777's starved run (80% of 5) despite every cell receiving 250 clean selections. Notably, within the informative pool the angle does NOT track score-axis magnitude (corr 0.028), and the single best-conditioned seed (17; D 0.497, norm_v_score 0.213) gives sin_angle 0.9883 -- near-perfect orthogonality. MECH-063 sub-claim (i) remains UNTESTED, and what evidence exists points toward the claim rather than its rival. The re-derive brake has FIRED for this lineage: route to /implement-substrate for a trained-enough probe substrate; a further instrument-only lettered iteration is REFUSED.

recommended_substrate_queue_entry.title: Trained-enough agent substrate for read-only control-plane telemetry probes
recommended_substrate_queue_entry.implementation_hint: The 2x2 read-only telemetry-probe family measures gain/bias regulators on the E3 softmax while running an UNTRAINED agent, whose action-value distribution is degenerate on ~64% of seeds (D_action_mass pinned at 0 or 1). A regulator that modulates a distribution is unobservable when that distribution has no dynamic range: corr(D-saturation-distance, norm_v_score) = 0.884, capping informative-seed yield at 28.6% and making the load-bearing criterion unreachable at feasible compute. Build a warmup/checkpoint stage that brings the agent to a non-degenerate action-value landscape (target: majority of seeds with D_action_mass_mean strictly inside (0.05, 0.95)) before telemetry collection begins, and record the realised per-seed saturation distribution so the yield is auditable. This is training-regime substrate enrichment for the probe harness -- the same class as the V3-EXQ-603c precedent -- not a ree_core mechanism change.

targets.fanout_exempt_reason: GOV-FANOUT-1 exempt: the bottleneck routes to a single unambiguous build (a trained-enough probe substrate), not to a discrimination among >=2 live hypotheses. The rival hypothesis H-collapse-one-scalar is not competing for the diagnosis here -- the run failed to observe, it did not observe collapse.
learning_extracted: A robustness bar written as mean - pstdev > margin is not sample-size-improvable: population dispersion does not shrink with n. Where the intent is 'effect exceeds its own noise', the standard error is the correct denominator; conflating seed variability with measurement noise makes a load-bearing criterion structurally unreachable.

Excluding a degenerate sample is not the same as repairing it. F2's saturation guard correctly stopped saturated seeds contributing a false angle, but left the saturation RATE untouched, converting a false signal into an underpowered one -- the honest next question is why the rate is 64%, not how to filter it.

A gain/bias regulator is only measurable when the distribution it modulates has dynamic range. corr(D-saturation-distance, norm_v_score) = 0.884 is the quantitative statement of that prerequisite, and it is a genuine biological dependency (trained, non-degenerate action-value landscapes) discovered by the FAIL.

Quantify the power ceiling before authorising another iteration. Computing 'seeds required at observed effect and dispersion' (~51 informative, ~177 raw, ~31 h) is what converts 'the bar is too strict' into a decidable substrate-vs-instrument verdict, and it is cheap.

An auto-derived evidence_direction produced a second consecutive artifact 'weakens' on MECH-063 from a criterion that never tested collinearity. A self-route label that contradicts the run's own headline statistic twice is a signal about the labelling logic, not about the claim.

Distinguishing WITHIN-pool from ACROSS-pool correlation was decisive: corr(v_score, sin) is 0.315 over all 14 seeds but 0.028 within the informative pool, which is what rules out a weak-axis-implies-collinear artifact contaminating the surviving seeds.

self_route_mismatch_adjudicated.question_posed: Is sample_starvation_requeue the right reading, or is SD-069 phasic_surprise_burst genuinely not firing (a capability question)?
self_route_mismatch_adjudicated.verdict: SAMPLING. The capability reading is RULED OUT. The manifest's own classification (preconditions[0].kind = 'sample', readiness_unmet_capability_kind = []) is correct.
evidence_capability_is_intact: burst_level_max = 1.00 in EVERY PHASIC-ON cell, including both seed-23 cells (T0P1 and T1P1). SD-069 fires at full amplitude on the offending seed.

Firing RATE on seed 23 is 7.19 (T1P1) and 11.86 (T0P1) event ticks per 1000 env steps, which sits INSIDE the range spanned by other seeds -- seed 29 runs 8.75 and 9.58, i.e. LOWER than seed 23's T0P1. There is no rate anomaly on seed 23.
Seed 23 received 835 and 843 env steps against 2400 for every other cell. Scaling seed 29's rate to 835 steps predicts ~7.7 ticks; 6 were observed. The shortfall is fully explained by exposure.
self_route_mismatch_adjudicated.root_cause: The 120-EPISODE cap, not the 2400-step cap, is what bound seed 23. Seed 23 dies in ~7 steps per episode, so 120 episodes exhausted at 835 steps -- 35% of the exposure every other seed received, with stop_reason 'episode_cap' while all 15 other starved cells report 'step_cap'.
self_route_mismatch_adjudicated.structural_reading: F1 sample-driven stopping fixed the STOPPING RULE but left the CAP episode-denominated. The original V3-EXQ-777/779 defect -- an episode-denominated budget silently truncating fast-dying seeds -- therefore reappeared in a new location rather than being eliminated. The fix moved the bottleneck.

why_the_withholding_is_correct.statement: Although the criterion passed, withholding it is the RIGHT call and the gate is not mis-scoped.
why_the_withholding_is_correct.reason: Seed 23 is one of the FOUR dissociating seeds (11, 23, 29, 37 dissociate; 17 fails C2) and carries the LARGEST phasic effect of any seed, dR_phasic = -0.10812811159965086, estimated on just 6 event ticks. Excluding seed 23 leaves 3 dissociating seeds against min_seeds 4, so the run would fail on seed count. The PASS therefore genuinely depends on the under-exposed cell, and the precondition correctly refused to bank it.
why_the_withholding_is_correct.contrast_with_predecessor: In V3-EXQ-779 the min-across-cells gate was criticised for letting a non-contributing dead cell veto a working run. Here the vetoing cell IS a contributor, and the strongest one -- so the same aggregation rule is doing legitimate work this time. Do not 'fix' the min-aggregation; fix the exposure.

The self-route sample_starvation_requeue is CORRECT and the capability reading is ruled out: burst_level_max is 1.00 in every PHASIC-ON cell including both seed-23 cells, and seed 23's firing rate (7.2-11.9 event ticks per 1000 env steps) sits inside the range other seeds span (seed 29: 8.8-9.6). targets.fanout_exempt_reason: GOV-FANOUT-1 exempt: single unambiguous one-parameter fix, no discrimination among rival hypotheses.
learning_extracted: Fixing a stopping RULE does not fix an episode-denominated CAP. F1 made sampling sample-driven but max_episodes_per_cell remained in episodes, so the identical starvation mechanism reappeared one layer down on the identical seed. When retiring a denomination bug, audit every budget in the file, not just the one that failed.

'stop_reason' is the diagnostic that separates the two starvation modes: 15 cells hit step_cap (genuinely long-running) while the single decisive cell hit episode_cap. Recording it per-cell is what made this a one-command diagnosis.

A rate check discriminates capability from exposure cheaply: normalising event ticks per 1000 env steps showed seed 23 firing at a rate INSIDE the range other seeds span, so the shortfall was exposure and not capability. Raw counts alone would have supported the opposite conclusion.

The sample-vs-capability precondition kind introduced by this iteration (readiness_unmet_sample_kind / readiness_unmet_capability_kind) worked as designed and is the reason the mislabelling of V3-EXQ-779 did not recur. Keep it in the probe template.

A min-across-cells gate is legitimate when the offending cell CONTRIBUTES to the criterion and pathological when it does not. The same aggregation rule was wrong in 779 and right in 779a -- the discriminating question is participation, not aggregation.

cluster_pattern.shape: Both runs inherit the same root -- per-seed heterogeneity in an untrained agent inside a hazard-terminating environment -- but it now expresses through two DIFFERENT channels, and the predecessor's fixes cleanly separated them. In 777a the channel is DYNAMIC RANGE (the score axis's dependent variable is saturated on 64% of seeds, capping informative yield at 28.6%); in 779a the channel is EXPOSURE (one fast-dying seed is truncated by an episode-denominated cap at 35% of the steps every other cell received).
cluster_pattern.structural_property: Seed-level heterogeneity in an untrained agent is the single upstream property. The predecessor autopsy diagnosed it as a SAMPLING defect and fixed sampling; sampling is now demonstrably repaired in 777a (250 selects on every cell, zero starved cells) and the saturation rate barely moved, which proves sampling was never the binding constraint for sub-claim (i). What the repair achieved was to SEPARATE the two channels so each could be diagnosed on its own terms -- which is why the two targets now route differently for the first time in this chain.
cluster_pattern.divergent_routing_is_the_finding: This is the first iteration in the 777/779 chain where the two sub-claims do NOT share a diagnosis. Sub-claim (i) is substrate-ceiling'd and brake-fired; sub-claim (ii) passed its criterion and needs one parameter. Treating them as one undifferentiated cluster from here would hold a nearly-complete result hostage to a substrate build it does not need.

reading_adjudication.substrate_enrichment: ACCEPTED for sub-claim (i) -- but as TRAINING-REGIME substrate (a non-degenerate action-value landscape for the regulator to act on), not as a ree_core mechanism gap. Both regulators under test are present and live.
reading_adjudication.test_design_ceiling: ACCEPTED for sub-claim (i) as a SECONDARY, contributing defect (c1_robust's population-SD denominator), and REJECTED as the dominant reading because repairing it still leaves the design needing ~51 informative seeds at a 28.6% yield. ACCEPTED as the sole reading for sub-claim (ii), where it is a one-parameter cap denomination.

claim_disposition.suggested_claim_note: Sub-claims (i) and (ii) remain experimentally untested as of 2026-07-18, but for now-DIFFERENT reasons -- the first divergence in this chain. V3-EXQ-777a and V3-EXQ-779a were adjudicated by failure_autopsy_MECH-063-777a-779a-cluster_2026-07-18. Sub-claim (i) (V3-EXQ-777a, non_contributory, substrate_ceiling): the predecessor's sampling fixes WORKED (every cell reached 250 fresh E3 selections, zero starved cells) and all six preconditions were met, yet C1 failed -- not on collinearity (mean_sin_angle 0.545 EXCEEDS the 0.500 margin and 3 of 4 informative seeds clear it) but on c1_robust, a bar defined as mean minus POPULATION SD and therefore unreachable at any n. Repairing it is insufficient: the design needs ~51 informative seeds at an observed 28.6% informative yield, and that yield is substrate-gated (corr(D-saturation-distance, norm_v_score) = 0.884; 9 of 14 seeds saturated) by an untrained agent's degenerate action-value distribution. claim_disposition.granularity_debt_recurrence_note: GOV-GRAN-1 P1 unflagged_recurrence discrimination (2026-07-18, session fervent-tereshkova-2f1c69). The audit flagged MECH-063 with 2 hits across 2 distinct signatures (chain 777 -> 779), now a 4-run chain with 777a and 779a. VERDICT: NOT granularity debt -> COHERENT substrate-build campaign circling ONE buildable gap (cf. the 460e..i lineage the /failure-autopsy docstring cites as a correct 'NOT granularity debt' adjudication, and the MECH-180 worked example). All four failures share a SINGLE upstream signature -- per-seed heterogeneity in an untrained agent inside a hazard-terminating environment -- recurring in successively narrower locations rather than as structurally distinct mechanisms: episode-denominated BUDGET (777, 779) -> dependent-variable SATURATION capping informative yield (777a) -> episode-denominated CAP truncating one contributor (779a). Each iteration eliminated the previous location and exposed the next, which is progressive localization, not bundled mechanisms. Two further facts weigh against the coarse-claim reading: the two sub-claims are cleanly SEPARABLE and are visibly separating (in this cycle they took different epistemic categories, different routings and different brake dispositions for the first time), and neither sub-claim has produced a falsification that a finer child claim would have caught -- sub-claim (ii) in fact PASSED its load-bearing criterion. No /claim-synthesis handoff is recommended. Re-evaluate if a future iteration produces a failure signature that does NOT reduce to per-seed heterogeneity.

recommended_followups.description: Trained-enough agent substrate for the read-only control-plane telemetry-probe family. Target: majority of seeds with D_action_mass_mean strictly inside (0.05, 0.95). Record the realised per-seed saturation distribution so informative yield is auditable.

changes: Step-denominate the per-cell cap: raise or remove max_episodes_per_cell (currently 120) so max_env_steps_per_cell (2400) is the binding constraint for every cell. Seed 23 exhausted 120 episodes at 835 steps because it dies in ~7 steps per episode, receiving 35% of the exposure every other cell received.
Keep the min-across-cells readiness aggregation UNCHANGED -- it did legitimate work here (the offending cell was the criterion's largest contributor). Do not relax it.
Keep the sample-vs-capability precondition kind classification; it is why the V3-EXQ-779 mislabelling did not recur.
Continue recording per-cell stop_reason -- it is what separated the one episode_cap cell from the 15 step_cap cells and made this a one-command diagnosis.

Expect adjudication on this run: the double dissociation already passed robustly on 4 seeds (mean_dS_tonic +0.265, mean_dR_phasic -0.048); the open question is only whether seed 23's dR_phasic (-0.108) survives adequate exposure.

recommended_followups.description: Sample-driven cell rollout helper, carried forward from the predecessor autopsy and now extended: budgets AND caps must both be denominated in the same unit as the gates that consume them (steps/selections, never episodes), and the helper must emit per-cell stop_reason plus realised step/episode/selection counts. The 779a episode-cap recurrence is the concrete case for the cap half of this.

Retire the mean-minus-population-SD robustness idiom from the telemetry-probe template. Where the intent is 'effect exceeds its own noise', use the standard error; where the intent is 'this holds on essentially every seed', state that as a seed-fraction bar (which c1_seed_count already does) rather than smuggling it into a dispersion test.
